dimensions.evidence: Observed GCC/Clang x86-64 sizes: ORNursery200,ORCards17,ORLargeHeap288,ORCCards640 bytes; concurrent control alignment64,packed metadata entry8. The metadata union reserves padded storage in both layout variants.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: C typed objects/declared extended alignment; host compiler observation.

dimensions.evidence: Minor retains all old cells and young closure from explicit+remembered roots; major uses explicit/pin roots. Nonmovable words are retained through associated descriptors, roots/strong edges and central pin tickets.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Graph invariant and actual ORGraph marker adapter; caller reserved-value discipline.

dimensions.evidence: Movable physical references rewrite during collection; large payload addresses stay fixed in a stationary region. Handles/tickets retire at generation4. Snapshot/lease cannot outlive its control; joined workers and discarded snapshots precede close.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime generations/revisions and external quiescence discipline.

dimensions.evidence: Serialized nursery/core; every mirrored old store uses the actual barrier adapter. Concurrent card fields/metadata use one mutex; private snapshots scan outside it. No global consistent collection snapshot is inferred.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: POSIX exclusion plus preflight/card invariants; not a C ownership type guarantee.

dimensions.evidence: No dynamic core allocation. Preflight checks every survivor destination before mutation. Second-survival promotions can exhaust8 old cells; major frees unreachable old cells before a retry. Large1..4-word first-fit rejects fragmented capacity despite sufficient total free words.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime capacity checks, independent occupied-set model and unchanged-state tests.

dimensions.evidence: Minor copies each unique surviving young cell once; major copies young survivors and compacts old descriptors left. Payload region never moves. Source immutability/destination ordering replace whole-heap staging, but card snapshots and planning arrays still copy.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Source proof, graph comparison and actual forwarding maps.

dimensions.evidence: Major is bounded by16 graph nodes; word clearing bounded by8 words; no recursive finalizers. Pins contribute roots until central ticket finish. Card mutex operations can block without a latency bound.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime state and fixed-capacity proof; caller lifetime obligations.

dimensions.evidence: O2 inspected actual calls: preflight invokes admitted/or_card_scan and direct or_card_store or rebuild; GCC includes stack-check helper. Card commit invokes pthread lock/unlock and Clang abort on impossible unlock failure. No helper-free target claim.

Real late-writer pthread schedule at all4 widths and2 placements; finite revisions reject stale snapshot commits unchanged. Positive and separately compiled controls passed declared TSan. Global concurrent copying, fairness and lock-free progress are outside the contract.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Mutex publication, revision check and bounded execution evidence.

dimensions.evidence: All nursery capacity/validation failures precede destination/root writes; old/copy/scanned outputs unchanged. Fragmentation admission preserves whole region. Card version mismatch preserves outputs and current dirty state; finite counters refuse wrap.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Runtime preflight plus targeted negative assertions and independent models.

dimensions.evidence: Actual6 configurations record clean/no-change/header builds. O2 GCC .717752/.048775/.658064s; Clang .480495/.044057/.392937s. A first probe attempt failed -Wmisleading-indentation in generated harness; braces fixed and failed report/log retained.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Exact commands and source hashes; no general compile-speed ranking.

dimensions.evidence: O2 whole-image text/data/bss GCC21122/664/16;Clang24694/648/16. Observed original minor vs preflight frames376 vs208 GCC,312 vs136 Clang. Major helper224/152; card commit64/40; large collect80/56. Calls/callee frames and ABI effects remain separate from local .su records.

dimensions.evidence: No persisted ABI for physical refs, snapshot owners, pins or mutex structs. Packed/padded traffic uses actual addresses under a64-byte model. perf absent: no hardware cache-miss/coherence count was obtained; no host settings changed.
dimensions.enforcer_and_limits: Explicit host model and unavailable-counter observation.

timing_scope: 1260 retained samples+84warmups. Each sample1000 full nursery lifecycles or card store/scan/clear rounds. Equal-root/payload/failure contracts include setup, validation/rebuild, promotion and major cleanup; traffic counters identify only their exact stages. Hardware events unavailable.

sealed_decision.choice: Preflight capacity with immutable from-space and stable left major compaction; keep a dedicated nonmovable first-fit region; use mutex/revision-checked per-card snapshot clearing.
sealed_decision.reason: Admission is decided before publication, native borrow address stability is explicit, and finite versions expose the late-clear window without unsynchronized payload reads.
sealed_decision.reopen_when: Change promotion policy, expose concurrent young mutation, make large payloads movable, add global concurrent collection or rely on a hardware cache-line/coherence claim.
